title: Decimal to Binary Conversion

content.problemStatement: Write a program to convert the decimal number to the binary form
content.inputFormat: Accept the number as an input

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.
Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.

solution.approach: Convert a decimal integer to binary string representation.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Extract bits using repeated modulo/division by 2, or format using built-in binary specifiers.

hints: Repeatedly take n % 2 and divide n by 2.
